watch.what: The click-through's long pole is a promotion
watch.detail: U-111 is critical tier, so it lands in integration; the experience page needs it in main. A same-day promotion keeps the Prototype about two sessions out.

watch.what: Review rounds, not building, set the pace
watch.detail: Wave 2 units merged in 2 to 5 rounds; builders took 9 to 29 minutes. Actuals run 75% or more under estimate, and the forecast does not learn from them yet.

watch.what: CI catches what agent reviews miss
watch.detail: gitleaks, CodeQL, and a database-free build caused four of wave 2's rounds. Wave 3 builders run those checks before reporting.

watch.what: The money core is the critical path
watch.detail: Holds, then payment intake, then confirming orders, then gifting. A slip there moves launch day for day.
Wave 3 has about five units adding tables; the PM sequences them so each regenerates on top of the last.

watch.what: U-005's job rules were the PM's call
watch.detail: Job kinds as text, retries and limits, time travel off by default. Check them at U-005's review and when the first email, reminder, and transfer handlers land: a wrong idempotency or retry rule shows up as double emails or double transfers.
